title: Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 通过强化学习实现安全图像生成

paragraphs.en: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的文本到图像（T2I）模型在视觉图像生成方面取得了显著成效，但它们仍然可能生成不适合工作场合（NSFW）的内容，包括暴力或露骨的图像。 现有的安全检测机制大多局限于生成前的过滤（例如提示层级的文本分类器），或在图像完全合成后进行的后续审核。 然而，对抗性攻击方法所作用的空间要广泛得多。 这种不平衡凸显了需要在生成过程中进行干预的安全机制的必要性。 我们提出了一种生成过程中的安全框架，该框架能够监控去噪轨迹，并从中间表示中检测出出现的 NSFW 信号。 我们的方法不仅限于单纯检测 NSFW 生成内容，还通过强化学习从 NSFW 提示中生成安全的图像。 通过将生成过程中的检测与可控引导相结合，我们的方法即使在生成已经开始后出现 NSFW 信号时，也能缓解不安全的生成轨迹。 实验结果表明，在标准评估集和对抗性评估集中，我们的方法始终优于现有的安全图像生成方法，同时保持了感知质量和提示保真度。 代码将在论文被接受后发布。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Image (T2I) models [ 37 , 9 ] have achieved remarkable progress in generating high-resolution images. Despite these advances, current T2I models still exhibit critical problems regarding safety: they can generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents [ 35 ] , including sexual and violent images as well as copyrighted or otherwise restricted materials. To mitigate these problems, a lot of research have proposed safety checkers intended to prevent models from generating NSFW contents.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型 [ 37 , 9 ] 在生成高分辨率图像方面取得了显著进展。 尽管取得了这些进步，当前的 T2I 模型在安全性方面仍存在关键问题：它们可能生成 NSFW（不适合工作场合）内容 [ 35 ]，包括性暗示和暴力图像，以及受版权保护或其他限制的材料。 为缓解这些问题，大量研究提出了安全检测工具，旨在防止模型生成 NSFW 内容。

sents.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型 [ 37 , 9 ] 在生成高分辨率图像方面取得了显著进展。

sents.en: Despite these advances, current T2I models still exhibit critical problems regarding safety: they can generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents [ 35 ] , including sexual and violent images as well as copyrighted or otherwise restricted materials.
sents.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步，当前的 T2I 模型在安全性方面仍存在关键问题：它们可能生成 NSFW（不适合工作场合）内容 [ 35 ]，包括性暗示和暴力图像，以及受版权保护或其他限制的材料。

sents.en: To mitigate these problems, a lot of research have proposed safety checkers intended to prevent models from generating NSFW contents.
sents.zh: 为缓解这些问题，大量研究提出了安全检测工具，旨在防止模型生成 NSFW 内容。

paragraphs.en: However, most existing safety checker architectures remain stage-limited and passive. The most common architecture is to block generation before the denoising process begins by applying text-based filtering at the prompt level [ 12 , 30 , 45 , 27 ] , or to reject final results after generation completes by classifying the final image in pixel space [ 35 , 39 , 23 ] . While such approaches are practical and widely deployed, they provide only passive protection. Therefore, they are vulnerable to adversarial attacks to generate NSFW contents, which can be applied throughout the whole T2I process.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大多数现有的安全检测器架构仍然局限于特定阶段且处于被动状态。 最常见的架构是在去噪过程开始前，通过提示词层面的文本过滤来阻止生成 [ 12 , 30 , 45 , 27 ]，或者在生成完成后，通过在像素空间中对最终图像进行分类来拒绝最终结果 [ 35 , 39 , 23 ]。 尽管这类方法实用且被广泛部署，但它们仅提供被动保护。 因此，它们容易受到对抗性攻击，从而生成 NSFW 内容，而这些攻击可能贯穿整个 T2I 过程。

sents.zh: 然而，大多数现有的安全检测器架构仍然局限于特定阶段且处于被动状态。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial attacks against safety checkers are increasingly multi-faceted and operate across multiple stages. Attack methods include prompt-based manipulations that evade text filters [ 44 , 28 , 20 ] , attacks targeting the guidance mechanisms, and latent-space attacks that directly perturb the denoising trajectory [ 36 , 35 , 26 ] . This asymmetry between attack surfaces and defense mechanisms exposes a key vulnerability: even if a safety checker is effective at one stage, an attacker can shift the attack to another stage where the defense is absent or weak.
paragraphs.zh: 针对安全检测器的对抗性攻击正变得越来越多样化，并跨越多个阶段进行。 攻击方法包括利用提示词进行操控以绕过文本过滤器的攻击 [ 44 , 28 , 20 ]、针对引导机制的攻击，以及直接扰动去噪轨迹的潜在空间攻击 [ 36 , 35 , 26 ]。 攻击面与防御机制之间的这种不对称性暴露了一个关键漏洞：即使安全检测器在某个阶段有效，攻击者也可以将攻击转移到另一个缺乏或防御薄弱的阶段。

paragraphs.en: Recent efforts have started to broaden the range of safety checkers beyond the prompt and final image. For example, Safe Latent Diffusion (SLD) [ 38 ] modifies intermediate representations by projecting latent states toward a “safe” subspace. Nevertheless, such approaches remain largely reactive and brittle because the checker operates as a one-shot safeguard, so they are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations injected after the safety applied.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始将安全检测器的范围从提示词和最终图像扩展到更广泛的层面。 例如，Safe Latent Diffusion (SLD) [ 38 ] 通过将潜在状态投影到一个“安全”的子空间来修改中间表示。 然而，这类方法在很大程度上仍然是反应式且脆弱的，因为检测器仅作为一次性的安全机制运行，因此容易受到在安全措施应用后注入的对抗性扰动的影响。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this gap, we propose the first framework that introduces an active reinforcement learning (RL) based safety checker agent that intervenes during the denoising trajectory of T2I models ( Figure 1 ). We treat the denoising process as an RL trajectory and formulate safety enforcement as a sequential decision-making problem. At each denoising timestep, an RL agent observes the current generation state and predicts whether the ongoing trajectory is likely to produce an NSFW output. When the agent detects high NSFW risk, it intervenes online to steer the trajectory toward safe generation by guiding the noise predicted, effectively transforming the unsafe path into a safe one rather than merely blocking or rejecting the output.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于这一空白，我们提出了首个引入主动强化学习（RL）基于安全检测的智能体的框架，该智能体会在 T2I 模型的降噪轨迹中进行干预（图 1）。 我们将降噪过程视为一条强化学习轨迹，并将安全执行问题建模为序列决策问题。 在每个降噪时间步中，一个强化学习智能体会观察当前的生成状态，并预测当前轨迹是否可能产生 NSFW 输出。 当智能体检测到较高的 NSFW 风险时，它会在线进行干预，通过引导预测的噪声将轨迹导向安全的生成方向，从而有效地将不安全的路径转化为安全路径，而不仅仅是阻止或拒绝输出。

sents.en: When the agent detects high NSFW risk, it intervenes online to steer the trajectory toward safe generation by guiding the noise predicted, effectively transforming the unsafe path into a safe one rather than merely blocking or rejecting the output.
sents.zh: 当智能体检测到较高的 NSFW 风险时，它会在线进行干预，通过引导预测的噪声将轨迹导向安全的生成方向，从而有效地将不安全的路径转化为安全路径，而不仅仅是阻止或拒绝输出。

paragraphs.en: This active, step-wise intervention provides three key advantages. First, even if adversarial attacks emerge after generation has already begun, the agent can still detect NSFW signals during generation and correct the trajectory before the final image is produced, providing robustness against multi-stage adversarial attacks [ 21 , 44 ] . Second, unlike existing safe image generation methods that require retraining or fine-tuning the T2I model, our framework keeps the pretrained T2I model fully frozen and trains only a lightweight intervention policy, enabling plug-and-play deployment across diverse T2I architectures including both diffusion models [ 37 ] and flow matching models [ 9 ] . Third, by incorporating a terminal aesthetic reward into the policy training objective, our method explicitly preserves perceptual quality alongside safety enforcement, avoiding the quality degradation commonly observed in existing approaches. In short, our method expands safety enforcement from a passive, stage specific checker into an adaptive, trajectory-aware control mechanism that is robust to attacks occurring at any point in the T2I generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 这种主动的分步干预方法具有三个关键优势。 首先，即使生成过程已经开始后出现了对抗性攻击，智能体仍然能够在生成过程中检测到 NSFW 信号，并在最终图像生成之前修正生成轨迹，从而有效抵御多阶段对抗性攻击 [ 21 , 44 ] 。 其次，与现有的安全图像生成方法不同，后者需要重新训练或微调 T2I 模型，而我们的框架则完全冻结预训练的 T2I 模型，仅训练一个轻量级的干预策略，从而能够跨多种 T2I 架构（包括扩散模型 [ 37 ] 和流匹配模型 [ 9 ] ）实现即插即用部署。 第三，通过将终端美学奖励纳入策略训练目标中，我们的方法在确保安全性的同时明确保留了感知质量，避免了现有方法中常见的质量下降问题。 简而言之，我们的方法将安全性验证从一种被动的、针对特定阶段的检查机制，扩展为一种自适应的、感知生成轨迹的控制机制，能够抵御 T2I 生成过程中任何阶段发生的攻击。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Image (T2I) Models. T2I models synthesize images conditioned on text prompts through an iterative sampling trajectory that progressively transforms a random latent variable into a clean image. This family includes both diffusion based models [ 16 ] , which learn to reverse a predefined noising process, and flow matching based models [ 25 ] , which learn a continuous vector field transporting samples from noise to data distribution. To reduce computational cost, practical T2I models operate in a compressed latent space via a variational autoencoder (VAE) [ 37 ] , decoding the final latent into pixel space after sampling. Prominent systems such as the Stable Diffusion family [ 37 , 9 ] combine pretrained text encoders with iterative generation models for textual conditioning. Despite their remarkable image quality and prompt alignment, these models continue to exhibit critical safety risks, particularly the generation of NSFW content.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型。 T2I 模型通过迭代采样轨迹生成受文本提示约束的图像，该过程逐步将随机潜在变量转化为清晰的图像。 这一类模型既包括基于扩散的模型 [ 16 ]，它们学习逆转预定义的噪声添加过程；也包括基于流匹配的模型 [ 25 ]，它们学习一个连续向量场，将样本从噪声传输到数据分布。 为降低计算成本，实用的 T2I 模型通过变分自编码器（VAE）[ 37 ] 在压缩的潜在空间中运行，并在采样后将最终潜在变量解码为像素空间。 像 Stable Diffusion 系列 [ 37 , 9 ] 这样的知名系统，将预训练的文本编码器和迭代生成模型结合，以实现文本约束。 尽管这些模型具有出色的图像质量和提示对齐能力，但它们仍然存在关键的安全风险，尤其是生成 NSFW 内容的问题。

paragraphs.en: NSFW Detection and Safety Checker. Safety checker research for T2I models broadly divides into two approaches. The first applies prompt-level filtering during the text embedding step, blocking generation when a prompt is detected as NSFW via similarity against the predefined NSFW words [ 12 , 30 , 45 , 27 ] . The second classifies the final generated image after the full denoising trajectory completes, measuring similarity against NSFW reference images [ 35 , 39 , 23 ] . Both approaches passively detect NSFW content at a single fixed stage– before or after generation– leaving the intermediate denoising trajectory entirely unconstrained and thus highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 非安全内容检测与安全检查器。 T2I模型的安全检查研究大致分为两种方法。 第一种方法在文本嵌入阶段应用提示词级过滤，当通过与预定义的非安全词汇进行相似度比对检测到提示词为非安全内容时，即阻止生成 [ 12 , 30 , 45 , 27 ] 。 第二种方法则在完整的去噪流程结束后对最终生成的图像进行分类，通过与非安全参考图像进行相似度测量来判断其安全性 [ 35 , 39 , 23 ] 。 这两种方法都在生成前或生成后这一单一固定阶段被动检测非安全内容，导致中间的去噪过程完全不受约束，因此极易受到对抗性攻击。

paragraphs.en: Safe Image Generation. To move beyond filtering, recent work on safe image generation has shifted toward converting NSFW content into safe outputs. A class of methods operates at the prompt or embedding level, detecting and purifying unsafe token embeddings by projecting them away from toxic concept subspaces using CLIP-based similarity [ 3 , 33 ] . Another class intervenes directly in the denoising trajectory, steering latent updates away from unsafe directions by conditioning on unsafe concept prompts at each diffusion step [ 38 ] . However, all of the above methods share a common limitation: they intervene at a single fixed stage of the pipeline. Since adversarial attacks can target every stage of the generation process– including the prompt, the denoising trajectory, and the final generated image– a one-stage correction leaves the system inherently vulnerable to attacks that operate at any other stage.
paragraphs.zh: 安全图像生成。 为了超越简单的过滤方法，近期关于安全图像生成的研究已转向将 NSFW 内容转换为安全的输出。 一类方法在提示词或嵌入层进行操作，通过基于 CLIP 的相似性度量，将不安全的词元嵌入从有毒概念子空间中投影出去，从而实现检测与净化 [ 3 , 33 ] 。 另一类方法则直接介入去噪轨迹，通过在每一步扩散过程中引入不安全概念提示词作为条件，引导潜在更新偏离不安全方向 [ 38 ] 。 然而，上述所有方法都存在一个共同局限：它们仅在流程的某个单一固定阶段进行干预。 由于对抗性攻击可能针对生成过程的各个阶段——包括提示词、去噪轨迹以及最终生成的图像——因此单阶段修正会使系统本质上仍易受任何其他阶段攻击的影响。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial Attack. Adversarial attacks against T2I safety checkers fall into two categories. Input-level attacks modify unsafe prompts to preserve NSFW semantics while reducing similarity to predefined NSFW keywords, evading prompt-based filters [ 46 , 26 , 20 , 28 ] . Output-level attacks instead manipulate the visual representation of the generated image so that unsafe semantics remain perceptually present while the image embedding shifts away from the checker’s reference concepts [ 43 , 36 , 6 ] . More recent multimodal attacks jointly exploit both modalities, optimizing adversarial prompts together with image-level perturbations to evade multiple safety components within the same pipeline [ 44 , 8 ] , creating a substantially broader attack surface than any single-stage checker can cover.
paragraphs.zh: 对抗性攻击。 针对 T2I 安全检测器的对抗性攻击可分为两类。 输入级攻击通过修改不安全提示，在保留 NSFW 语义的同时降低其与预定义 NSFW 关键词的相似度，从而绕过基于提示的过滤器 [ 46 , 26 , 20 , 28 ] 。 输出级攻击则通过操控生成图像的视觉表现，使不安全语义在感知上仍然存在，同时图像嵌入偏离检测器的参考概念 [ 43 , 36 , 6 ] 。 更近期的多模态攻击会同时利用两种模态，联合优化对抗性提示和图像级扰动，以规避同一流程中的多个安全组件 [ 44 , 8 ] ，从而形成比任何单阶段检测器所能覆盖的范围大得多的攻击面。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion RL. Diffusion RL aims to align generative models with downstream objectives that are difficult to optimize using standard supervised losses, including human preference, aesthetic quality, and prompt-image alignment. Existing methods typically formulate the denoising trajectory as a sequential decision process and compute rewards from the final generated image. DDPO [ 1 ] uses policy gradients with terminal image-level rewards, DPOK [ 10 ] adds KL regularization to constrain deviations from the pretrained model, and differentiable-reward methods such as AlignProp [ 34 ] and DRaFT [ 7 ] backpropagate rewards through the denoising trajectory. B 2 -DiffuRL [ 18 ] further mitigates sparse credit assignment with backward progressive training. However, these methods still primarily rely on final image-level rewards, making it difficult to determine which intermediate denoising steps caused the desired or undesired outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散强化学习。 扩散强化学习的目标是将生成模型与下游任务目标对齐，而这些目标难以通过标准的监督损失进行优化，包括人类偏好、美学质量和提示-图像对齐。 现有方法通常将去噪轨迹建模为序列决策过程，并根据最终生成的图像计算奖励。 DDPO [ 1 ] 使用策略梯度并结合终端图像级奖励；DPOK [ 10 ] 增加了 KL 正则化以约束模型与预训练模型的偏离；而可微分奖励方法（如 AlignProp [ 34 ] 和 DRaFT [ 7 ]）则通过去噪轨迹反向传播奖励。 B 2 -DiffuRL [ 18 ] 进一步通过向后渐进式训练缓解了稀疏的信用分配问题。 然而，这些方法仍然主要依赖最终的图像级奖励，因此难以确定哪些中间去噪步骤导致了期望或不希望的结果。

paragraphs.en: Overview. We formulate the denoising process of a pretrained T2I model as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) [ 2 , 4 ] , in which the agent observes only the current denoising state rather than having access to the full denoising trajectory. And a lightweight actor-critic network intervenes at selected denoising timesteps to steer the generation trajectory away from unsafe content. Unlike prior diffusion RL approaches [ 18 , 1 ] that fine-tune the entire denoising network end-to-end with terminal rewards, our framework keeps the pretrained model fully frozen and trains only the intervention policy with a decomposed reward combining timestep-weighted intermediate NSFW feedback and a terminal aesthetic reward, providing dense credit assignment throughout the trajectory. Furthermore, unlike deterministic safe image generation methods that apply a fixed one-shot correction, our RL policy adaptively determines the direction and strength of intervention at each timestep, with each action reshaping the entire subsequent denoising trajectory. We further extend the framework to flow matching models, making our approach the first RL-based safety framework applicable to both diffusion and flow matching T2I models.
paragraphs.zh: 概述。 我们将预训练 T2I 模型的降噪过程建模为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）[2, 4]，其中智能体仅能观察到当前的降噪状态，而无法获取完整的降噪轨迹。 此外，一个轻量级的演员-评论家网络会在选定的降噪时间步进行干预，以引导生成轨迹偏离不安全的内容。 与先前通过终端奖励对整个降噪网络进行端到端微调的扩散 RL 方法 [18, 1] 不同，我们的框架完全冻结预训练模型，仅使用分解后的奖励来训练干预策略；该奖励结合了按时间步加权的中间 NSFW 反馈和终端美学奖励，从而在整个轨迹中提供密集的信归因。 此外，与采用固定单次修正的确定性安全图像生成方法不同，我们的 RL 策略能够在每个时间步自适应地确定干预的方向和强度，而每次动作都会重塑整个后续的降噪轨迹。 我们还进一步将这一框架扩展到流匹配模型，使我们的方法成为首个适用于扩散和流匹配两类 T2I 模型的基于 RL 的安全框架。

paragraphs.en: We construct our training dataset using prompts from the I2P dataset [ 38 ] . We collect 200 prompts per category (self-harm, violence, shocking content, hate, harassment, sexual, and illegal activity), resulting in 1,400 NSFW prompts in total. For the clean data, we use the COCO2014 captions dataset [ 24 ] . Each image is paired with five human-written captions: We take the first caption for each image and randomly sample 1,400 captions of these first captions. We construct a balanced training dataset (1,400 NSFW vs. 1,400 Clean prompts).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 I2P 数据集 [38] 中的提示来构建训练数据集。 我们按类别收集了 200 个提示（自我伤害、暴力、令人震惊的内容、仇恨、骚扰、性内容和非法活动），总共得到 1,400 个 NSFW 提示。 对于干净数据，我们使用 COCO2014 图像描述数据集 [24]。 每张图像都配有五个由人类撰写的图像描述：我们取每张图像的第一个图像描述，并从这些第一个图像描述中随机抽取 1,400 个。 我们构建了一个平衡的训练数据集（1,400 个 NSFW 提示与 1,400 个干净提示）。

paragraphs.en: We implement our method on Stable Diffusion v1.5 [ 37 ] , Stable Diffusion v2.0, and Stable Diffusion v3.0 [ 9 ] . We opt for a DDIM Scheduler for SD v1.5 and SD v2.0 and a FlowMatch Euler scheduler for SD v3.0. paragraphs.en: We compare our method against the SLD [ 38 ] , SAFREE [ 47 ] , PurifyGen [ 3 ] , UCE [ 11 ] , and RECE [ 14 ] . We use two performace metrics: Inappropriate Probability and Expected Maximum Inappropriateness. Inappropriate Probability measures the overall risk of the model generating NSFW contents. An image is classified as NSFW if the NSFW score exceeds a threshold of 0.5. Expected Maximum Inappropriateness evaluates the worst-case scenario, estimating the maximum proportion of inappropriate images a user is expected to encounter within a batch of 25 prompts. paragraphs.en: Effect of intermediate reward. Removing the intermediate reward and relying solely on the terminal reward (w/o intermediate reward) leads to a substantial increase in Inappropriate Probability on both Naive and Adversarial sets, confirming that dense step-wise credit assignment is critical for effective policy learning. Without intermediate feedback, the policy struggles to identify which denoising decisions contributed to unsafe outcomes, consistent with the sparse reward problem highlighted in Section 3.2 .

paragraphs.en: Effect of Recurrent Policy. To validate the benefit of history-aware policy over memoryless alternatives, we compare three variants: (i) memoryless MLP , which conditions only on the current observation 𝒐 t \boldsymbol{o}_{t} ; (ii) frame stacking ( f = 3 f=3 ), which concatenates the last f f observations and actions as an approximation of history without recurrence; and (iii) our GRU-based policy , which maintains a hidden belief state 𝒉 t \boldsymbol{h}_{t} across the full episode. As shown in Table 5 , the GRU-based policy outperforms both Naive and Adversarial set, confirming that temporal reasoning over the denoising history is beneficial for robust safety enforcement.

paragraphs.en: Unlike existing methods that passively perform one-shot safe image generation, we proposed an active RL framework to monitor the generation process while inverting NSFW prompts to safe images. All experiments showed that our approach outperforms other methods across various T2I models. paragraphs.en: Tables 12 and 13 summarize the results. Smaller intervals yield marginally lower Inappropriate Probability and Expected Maximum Inappropriateness by intervening more frequently, but at increased inference cost. For SD v1.5, performance degrades gradually up to m = 5 m=5 but increases sharply from m = 6 m=6 , as unsafe content emerges and propagates further between infrequent probing steps before it can be corrected. A similar pattern holds for SD v3.0, where the sharp increase begins after m = 4 m=4 , consistent with its shorter 28-step sampling trajectory leaving less room between probing steps for a spike in NSFW score to accumulate. We therefore select m = 5 m=5 for SD v1.5 and m = 4 m=4 for SD v3.0, as these are the largest intervals before this sharp degradation, offering the best trade-off between safety performance and inference efficiency.

paragraphs.en: We provide full experiment details for the robustness evaluation against mid-generation latent attacks described in Section 4.5 . The goal of this experiment is to assess whether our framework can detect and correct NSFW content injected during the denoising process, a threat scenario that prompt-level and output-level defenses are structurally incapable of addressing. paragraphs.en: C.1 Dataset and Prompts. We construct the evaluation set using 200 prompts sampled from the sexual category of the I2P dataset [ 38 ] , with no overlap with the training set. For each prompt, we pair it with a semantically matched safe prompt that preserves the same subject and scene composition while removing unsafe attributes. Specifically, the paired safe prompt is constructed by replacing unsafe descriptors with neutral alternatives, while keeping the subject identity, pose, and scene context unchanged (e.g., wearing clothes → \to nudity ). Generation is initially conditioned on the safe prompt and the NSFW prompt is substituted at the attack timestep t ∗ t^{*} , while the latent state 𝒛 t ∗ \boldsymbol{z}_{t^{*}} and random seed remain unchanged. This setting isolates the effect of mid-generation prompt substitution from other sources of variation. All experiments are conducted on SD v1.5 with 50 DDIM denoising steps and CFG scale ω = 7.5 \omega=7.5 .
paragraphs.zh: C.1 数据集与提示词。 我们从 I2P 数据集 [38] 的性相关类别中采样了 200 个提示词来构建评估集，这些提示词与训练集没有任何重叠。 对于每个提示词，我们都为其配上一个语义匹配的“安全”提示词，该提示词保留了相同的主体和场景构图，同时移除了不安全属性。 具体而言，配对的安全提示词通过将不安全的描述词替换为中性的替代词来构建，同时保持主体的身份、姿势和场景背景不变（例如，“穿着衣物”→“裸体”）。 生成过程最初以安全提示词为条件，并在攻击时间步 t* 时替换为非安全提示词，而潜在状态 z_{t*} 和随机种子保持不变。 这种设置将生成过程中期提示词替换的影响与其他变化来源隔离开来。 所有实验均在 SD v1.5 上进行，使用 50 步 DDIM 去噪和 CFG 尺度 ω = 7.5。

paragraphs.en: C.3 Results. Table 14 compares Inappropriate Probability and CLIP Score across vanilla SD v1.5 [ 37 ] , SLD [ 38 ] , and our method under the three attack timesteps. Note that since prompt-level and output-level defenses including SAFREE [ 47 ] , PurifyGen [ 3 ] , UCE [ 11 ] , and RECE [ 14 ] do not monitor or correct the intermediate denoising trajectory, they provide no meaningful protection against latent-space injection attacks. SLD, while operating in latent space, applies a state-independent correction, thus remains vulnerable when the attack is injected after its correction has been applied. In contrast, our method continuously monitors the NSFW score s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} and maintains the hidden state 𝒉 t \boldsymbol{h}_{t} that accumulates evidence of trajectory deviation across timesteps. When an attack is injected, the resulting spike in s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} is detected at the next probe step, and the policy immediately increases its intervention strength a t a_{t} to suppress the unsafe direction. This mechanism is particularly effective for early- and mid-stage attacks where sufficient denoising steps remain for the correction to propagate through the trajectory. Late-stage attacks ( t ∗ = 15 t^{*}=15 ) remain more challenging due to the limited remaining denoising horizon.
paragraphs.zh: C.3 结果。 表 14 比较了三种方法在三个攻击时间步中的“不当概率”和 CLIP 分数：基础版 SD v1.5 [ 37 ]、SLD [ 38 ] 以及我们的方法。 请注意，由于提示层和输出层防御方法（包括 SAFREE [ 47 ]、PurifyGen [ 3 ]、UCE [ 11 ] 和 RECE [ 14 ]）不会监控或修正中间的去噪轨迹，因此它们无法有效抵御潜在空间注入攻击。 SLD 虽然在潜在空间中运行，但采用了一种与状态无关的修正方式，因此当攻击在其修正完成之后注入时，它仍然容易受到攻击。 相比之下，我们的方法会持续监控 NSFW 分数 s ^ t \hat{s}_{t}，并维护隐藏状态 𝒉 t \boldsymbol{h}_{t}，该状态会在不同时间步中累积轨迹偏离的证据。 当攻击被注入时，s ^ t \hat{s}_{t} 的骤升会在下一个探测步骤中被检测到，此时策略会立即增强干预强度 a t a_{t}，以抑制不安全方向的变化。 这种机制对早期和中期攻击尤其有效，因为此时仍有足够的去噪步数，使修正能够贯穿整个轨迹。 晚期攻击（ t ∗ = 15 t^{*}=15 ）仍然更具挑战性，因为此时剩余的去噪步数非常有限。

paragraphs.en: Training Setup. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. The pretrained T2I models — SD v1.5 [ 37 ] , SD v2.0, and SD v3.0 [ 9 ] — are kept fully frozen throughout policy training. We use the DDIM scheduler [ 42 ] with T = 50 T=50 denoising steps for all diffusion based T2I models, and the FlowMatch Euler scheduler for flow matching T2I models. The policy is applied every 5 denoising steps for diffusion based T2I models and every 4 denoising steps for flow matching T2I model. A separate policy is trained for each T2I model with observation dim ( 𝒐 t ) = 8 ​ C + 2 \dim(\boldsymbol{o}_{t})=8C+2 , where C = 4 C=4 is the number of channel for SD v1.5/v2.0 and C = 16 C=16 for SD v3.0. All policies are trained for 20,000 episodes with mini-batches of size 128 sampled from collected trajectories. We use the Adam optimizer with a fixed learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and no learning rate scheduling.
paragraphs.zh: 训练设置。 所有实验均在单块 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上进行。 预训练的 T2I 模型——SD v1.5 [ 37 ]、SD v2.0 和 SD v3.0 [ 9 ]——在整个策略训练过程中均保持完全冻结。 对于所有基于扩散的 T2I 模型，我们使用 DDIM 调度器 [ 42 ]，设置 T = 50 T=50 个去噪步骤；而对于流匹配 T2I 模型，则使用 FlowMatch Euler 调度器。 对于基于扩散的 T2I 模型，策略每 5 个去噪步骤执行一次；而对于流匹配 T2I 模型，则每 4 个去噪步骤执行一次。 我们为每个 T2I 模型训练一个独立的策略，其观测维度为 ( 𝒐 t ) = 8 ​ C + 2 \dim(\boldsymbol{o}_{t})=8C+2，其中 C = 4 C=4 是 SD v1.5/v2.0 的通道数，而 C = 16 C=16 是 SD v3.0 的通道数。 所有策略均训练 20,000 个回合，每个回合使用从收集到的轨迹中采样的大小为 128 的小批量数据。 我们使用 Adam 优化器，固定学习率为 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4}，且不使用学习率调度。

paragraphs.en: Policy Architecture. The actor-critic network consists of a two-layer MLP encoder ( ( 8 ​ C + 2 ) → 256 (8C+2)\to 256 , SiLU + LayerNorm) followed by a single-layer GRU with hidden size 256. The actor head is a linear projection from the GRU hidden state to two scalars ( u t , v t ) (u_{t},v_{t}) parameterizing the beta distribution. paragraphs.en: While our framework demonstrates strong empirical performance, several limitations remain. First, the latent safety probe g ϕ g_{\phi} is distilled from a fixed teacher pipeline (VAE decoding combined with external NSFW detectors), so its accuracy is fundamentally bounded by the coverage and biases of these teacher signals; unsafe concepts not well captured by the teacher detectors may not be reliably identified by the probe. Second, the action space is a single scalar intervention strength applied along one safe direction per timestep; this design may be insufficient for prompts that entangle multiple distinct unsafe concepts requiring different correction directions simultaneously. Third, our robustness evaluation focuses on PGD-based in-generation attacks under a specific threat model; robustness against other adaptive or black-box attack strategies not considered in this work remains an open question. Finally, although the policy is lightweight relative to the full pixel-space safety pipeline, it still introduces additional inference-time computation compared to methods that require no online intervention, which may matter in latency-sensitive deployment settings.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的框架在实证中展现出强劲的性能，但仍存在若干局限性。 首先，潜在安全探针 g ϕ g_{\phi} 是从一个固定的教师流程（VAE 解码与外部 NSFW 检测器结合）中蒸馏而来的，因此其准确性从根本上受限于这些教师信号的覆盖范围与偏差；若教师检测器未能有效捕捉到某些不安全概念，该探针可能无法可靠地识别出这些概念。 其次，动作空间在每个时间步仅沿单一安全方向施加一个标量干预强度；对于需要同时以不同方向进行修正、且交织了多个独立不安全概念的提示而言，这种设计可能并不充分。 第三，我们的鲁棒性评估聚焦于特定威胁模型下基于 PGD 的生成内攻击；而对于本研究未涉及的其他自适应或黑盒攻击策略，其鲁棒性仍是一个待解决的问题。 最后，尽管该策略相较于完整的像素空间安全流程更为轻量，但与无需在线干预的方法相比，它仍然会增加推理时的计算开销，这在延迟敏感的部署场景中可能具有重要意义。
